findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed an old spill on the floor of the walk in cooler right next to the door. Discussed with PIC. Ensure this is spill is cleaned up to remove soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed mop buckets to contain old mop water. Discussed with PIC. Ensure mop water is disposed of properly as soon as it is done being used.
findings.citation_text: 5-403.12 Other Liquid Wastes and Rainwater. Condensate drainage and other nonSEWAGE liquids and rainwater shall be drained from point of discharge to disposal according to LAW.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The cages of the fan in the walk-in cooler with milk are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil residues on them and the surrounding surfaces. Have these adjacent surfaces and the cages cleaned to remove the dust/soil. Ensure the cleaning of these items takes place at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11:  (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The door stop for the restroom door is observed to have been pulled out of the wall with some of the baseboard coving material pulled away with it. Ensure these items are repaired to have the coving material reattached to the wall and that the door stop is reattached.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed soils in various areas in the facility, some in the storage back room on the floor, some soils on the cold holding equipment in the display sections where product has spilt or dust/soils have accumulated, such as the yogurt cooler and milk coolers. Ensure surface cleaning of the display areas and back room floors take place to remove soil/debris.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Proper disposition of returned, previously served, reconditioned and unsafe food
findings.comment:
3-701.11: There was an observed case of Kroger Brand Non Stick Extra Virgin Olive Oil Cooking Spray on the shelves which had visible leakage taking place with an expiration date of 15SEP2023. There are no cans present that match the 2019 expiration date associated with complaint #21-0719. These damaged products were removed form service and prohibited from sale. The reminding cases of cooking spray are in good condition. Ensure that products are placed and maintained on the shelves in good condition.
3-701.11: (A) FOOD unsafe, ADULTERATED, or not honestly presented shall be discarded or reconditioned. (B) FOOD not from APPROVED source shall be discarded. (C) RTE FOOD that may have been contaminated from RESTRICTED/EXCLUDED employee shall be discarded. (D) FOOD contaminated by hands, bodily discharges, or other means shall be discarded.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a significant amount of ice accumulation in the walk in freezer around the door and on the fan covers. Defrost freezer and maintain free from ice accumulation.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the green carts in the back to be soiled with food debris and soil in general. 2) Observed the salt shelves in the retail portion to be soiled with spillage. Clean non-food contact areas.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed a mop bucket with soiled water in it and the mop head stored down in the soiled water in the mop sink room. Mop buckets should be emptied after use and mop heads hung to dry in between use.
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the floors to be soiled with milk spillage underneath the shelves in the walk in cooler. 2) Observed debris such as cans underneath the retail shelves. Clean the floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed food to be discarded in open bins near one of the back doors. There are plastic bins holding spilled beverages and old produce in this area. This is going to lead to a pest problem if food is not handled in a manner to reduce pests.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed spilled milk in various places of the produce walk in cooler. Clean floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed food debris and food splash at the bottom of multiple coolers and reach in freezers(meat cooler). Clean non food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.citation_text: 750.100 Observed multiple dented cans. Removed cans to CORRECT the violation.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g
Obtain a test kit for checking the strength of the chlorine-based sanitizer used in spray bottles around the store.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Three cans of potentially hazardous food were found on shelves that were dented on seams.  They were pulled from the shelves to be returned to Kroger or destroyed to CORRECT the violation.

750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
There was no test kit for the chlorine-based sanitizer at the mop sink that is used in spray bottles around the store.   Obtain a test kit (Ecolab product is being used) that will work with the chlorine-based sanitizer.  The concentration should be 100-150 ppm chlorine.

750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
The following doors had gaps to the outside that could allow insects or rodents to enter the store:
  1.  front sliding door (one to the outside) - gap under it and in the corners
  2.  under the left garage door in the receiving area in back - gap at the lower left and under the door.  It does not close well without forcing it.
  3.  back exterior door to the dumpster area - weak closer, will not close completely without help
Repair the doors so they close all the way on their own and with no gaps around them.

750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
